query: What adversarial-robustness targets (max GPS offset, message-loss rate, CT error magnitude) should be specified so detection degradation stays below X%, and how will we generate and measure those adversarial scenarios?

response.query: What adversarial-robustness targets (max GPS offset, message-loss rate, CT error magnitude) should be specified so detection degradation stays below X%, and how will we generate and measure those adversarial scenarios?
response.answer: Adversarial robustness targets should specify max GPS offset, message-loss rate, and CT error magnitude below X%. Adversarial scenarios are generated by introducing controlled perturbations and measured via performance degradation metrics.
